findings.evidence: upstream/mathlib/Mathlib/Data/Finset/Image.lean:480 `theorem image_inter [DecidableEq α] (s₁ s₂ : Finset α) (hf : Injective f) : (s₁ ∩ s₂).image f = s₁.image f ∩ s₂.image f`; :504 `theorem image_sdiff [DecidableEq α] {f : α → β} (s t : Finset α) (hf : Injective f) : (s \ t).image f = s.image f \ t.image f`.
findings.fix: Prove the two ingredients once — `(C.valence h).image Species.conj = C.valence (C.conj h)` (from `mem_valence_conj` + `Species.conj_conj`) and `(Species.flavorPair i).image Species.conj = Species.flavorPair i` (`Finset.image_insert`, `Finset.image_singleton`, `Finset.pair_comm`) — then both lemmas are `rw [Finset.image_inter _ _ Species.conj_involutive.injective, …]` resp. `rw [Finset.image_sdiff _ _ Species.conj_involutive.injective, …]`.
findings.issue: `image_conj_inter_valence` (342) and `image_conj_sdiff_valence` (352) are the same 7-line `ext` proof twice (differing only in `Finset.mem_inter` vs `Finset.mem_sdiff`), and both re-derive `Finset.image_inter`/`Finset.image_sdiff`.

findings.evidence: Symmetries.lean:251-254 `favoured_add_unfavoured`; Mathlib/Data/Finset/Lattice/Lemmas.lean:120,131,152,156 for the insert/singleton intersection lemmas.
findings.fix: Derive each from the earlier line: from `favoured + unfavoured = D h (quark i) + D h (antiquark i)` and `favoured_eq_apply_quark hq hq'`, `unfavoured = D h (antiquark i)` follows by `linarith`/`add_left_cancel` (symmetrically for the other). For the two remaining `hset` computations in `favoured_eq_apply_quark`/`favoured_eq_apply_antiquark`, use `Finset.insert_inter_of_mem`/`Finset.insert_inter_of_notMem` with `Finset.singleton_inter_of_mem`/`singleton_inter_of_notMem` on `flavorPair i = {quark i, antiquark i}` instead of `ext`.
findings.issue: `unfavoured_eq_apply_antiquark` (286) and `unfavoured_eq_apply_quark` (318) recompute the `flavorPair \ valence` singleton by hand, although `favoured_add_unfavoured` (251) together with the matching `favoured_eq_apply_*` already determines them.

findings.evidence: Symmetries.lean:459-466 and 473-479 differ only in the membership-transport step.
findings.fix: Prove once `valenceStepFrag C (τ h) (σ s) z Q2 = valenceStepFrag C h s z Q2` from `∀ h s, σ s ∈ C.valence (τ h) ↔ s ∈ C.valence h`, then instantiate at `σ := Species.conj` (hypothesis `(C.mem_valence_conj h (Species.conj s)).trans (by rw [Species.conj_conj])`) and at `σ := Species.map ρ` (hypothesis `hv`).
findings.issue: `chargeConjRelation_valenceStepFrag` (457) and `flavorRelation_valenceStepFrag` (470) are the identical `by_cases hz / by_cases hs` proof twice; both relations have the shape `D (τ h) (σ s) = D h s`.
`IsValenceFlavor.quark_mem_iff` repeats the `rcases` case bash of `IsValenceFlavor.antiquark_mem_iff`; it is the logical contrapositive of it.

summary: The new material (ValenceContent, the two relations, favoured/unfavoured, the pion instance) is not duplicated anywhere in Mathlib, Physlib, TauCeti or EpsilonEridani. But four proof blocks re-derive located Mathlib lemmas or results proved earlier in the same file, and two pairs of them are copies of each other.
